summary: The Real Brokerage Inc. filed a 6-K announcing the deadline for RE/MAX stockholders to elect merger consideration in Real's pending acquisition of RE/MAX. Stockholders of record must submit elections by August 18, 2026. Non-electing shares convert to 5.15 Real REMAX shares (adjusted to 0.515 pre-closing) subject to proration. The deal is pending shareholder approval and customary conditions. What to watch: the election deadline, proration risk, and regulatory approvals.
